comments.body: hi @nazariig  @dgsudharsan could you help to elaborate what's the cons to disable FRR next hop group support?

comments.author: dgsudharsan
comments.body:
> hi @nazariig @dgsudharsan could you help to elaborate what's the cons to disable FRR next hop group support?

I believe there is no cons. If the NOS is using the nexthop group, it will affect performance. However SONiC is not using nexthop group today. Hence there is no impact with respect to SONiC
